fine_trace.note: The decoder reads transform block coefficients, using a context that may contain uninitialized values when the bitstream is malformed.
The coefficient CDF table is selected based on the transform block context; a malformed bitstream can cause an uninitialized context index to be used.
The boolean entropy decoder reads from the range coder state; when the CDF or context is uninitialized, the value read is uninitialized, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value report.
